notes.title: 🔍 Update 1.1 Now Live!
notes.content:
We’ve released a new update for My Wife’s Cheating on Me! — making your emotional rollercoaster just a little smoother:

💔 Scene Gallery Improvements – Rewatch unlocked scenes with cleaner transitions and improved playback.
🛠️ Bug Fixes – Fixed stuck dialogues, timing issues, and some visual hiccups.
⚡ Performance Boost – Faster load times, better responsiveness, and overall smoother experience.
📐 Minor UI Tweaks – Cleaner menus and easier navigation throughout the story.

Thanks for playing and for all the feedback — every comment helps us improve! If you're enjoying the twisted drama, consider leaving a review 💬

👉 Haven’t caught her in the act yet? Add to your wishlist and get ready for a wild ride through lies, lust, and shattered trust.

More drama (and updates) on the way! 💋
